answer: An operator's kth identity must bring k sponsors, each holding a vault whose mirror shares no entry with the operator's. Every sponsor locks one comet under that identity, and the operator's vault records the sponsor set so no sponsor serves twice. A newcomer brings one sponsor; the tenth brings ten; the thousandth brings a thousand, so a thousand clones require 500,500 distinct outside sponsors, each locking one comet. A fresh vault imports the old mirror, so a new key cannot shrink the required set.
